items.problem: The threading recipe introduced an ambiguous DispatcherQueue name when Windows.System remained imported.
items.evidence: Scoring session lines 731 and 738 report CS0104 between Microsoft.UI.Dispatching.DispatcherQueue and Windows.System.DispatcherQueue after migration turn 15 applied the threading recipe.
items.proposed_improvement: Keep the existing threading recipe but add a prominent alias example for files that also need Windows.System, especially for Launcher.
items.generalizes: Windows.System is common in UWP shell and page code, so the otherwise-correct dispatcher migration repeatedly creates the same CS0104 collision.
